# {{< fa square-check >}} &nbsp;Choosing a data file format

## Why are there different file formats?

- A file format defines **how information** is **organised**, **represented** and **stored**

- There is no universal file format: **each format addresses different needs**

. . .

<br>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column .center width=25%}

[{{< fa layer-group size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #4A8C78;"}
<br>

[**Nature**]{style="color: #4A8C78 !important;"}

::: {.small}
Tabular data, text, images, spatial data, bibliographic data, etc.
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=25%}

[{{< fa sitemap size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #C18A45;"}
<br>

[**Structure**]{style="color: #C18A45 !important;"}

::: {.small}
Tabular, hierarchical, relational, multidimensional, etc.
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=25%}

[{{< fa file-lines size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #075a80;"}
<br>

[**Representation**]{style="color: #075a80 !important;"}

::: {.small}
Text-based or binary
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=25%}

[{{< fa lock-open size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #795F8D;"}
<br>

[**Openness**]{style="color: #795F8D !important;"}

::: {.small}
Open or proprietary formats
:::
:::

::::

<br>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column .center width=12.5%}
:::

::: {.column .center width=25%}

[{{< fa right-left size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #C76D62;"}
<br>

[**Interoperability**]{style="color: #C76D62 !important;"}

::: {.small}
Compatibility with<br>different software and OS
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=25%}

[{{< fa gauge-high size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #795F8D;"}
<br>

[**Performance**]{style="color: #795F8D !important;"}

::: {.small}
File size,<br>reading and writing speed
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=25%}

[{{< fa box-archive size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #C18A45;"}
<br>

[**Long-term preservation**]{style="color: #C18A45 !important;"}

::: {.small}
Ability to store, access and reuse data<br>over time
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=12.5%}
:::

::::


## What types of data and file formats?

<br>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column .center width=25%}

[{{< fa table size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #4A8C78;"}
<br>

[**Tabular data**]{style="color: #4A8C78 !important;"}

::: {.small}
Data organised into rows and columns, with variables and observations

**`.csv`** &nbsp; **`.tsv`** &nbsp; **`.xlsx`** &nbsp; **`.ods`**
:::
:::

::: {.column .center .fragment width=25%}

[{{< fa code size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #C18A45;"}
<br>

[**(Semi-)structured data**]{style="color: #C18A45 !important;"}

::: {.small}
Data organised according to a defined structure, which may be hierarchical or relational

**`.json`** &nbsp; **`.yaml`** &nbsp; **`.xml`** &nbsp; **`.sql`**
:::
:::

::: {.column .center .fragment width=25%}

[{{< fa file-lines size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #075a80;"}
<br>

[**Unstructured data**]{style="color: #075a80 !important;"}

::: {.small}
Documents, web pages and other content without a predefined tabular structure

**`.txt`** &nbsp; **`.html`** &nbsp; **`.md`** &nbsp; **`.pdf`**
:::
:::

::: {.column .center .fragment width=25%}

[{{< fa map size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #795F8D;"}
<br>

[**Spatial data**]{style="color: #795F8D !important;"}

::: {.small}
Data describing geographical objects (vector data) or information on a grid (raster data)

**`.shp`** &nbsp; **`.gpkg`** &nbsp; **`.geotiff`** &nbsp; **`.netcdf`**
:::
:::

::::

<br><br>


:::: {.columns}

::: {.column .center width=12.5%}
:::

::: {.column .center .fragment width=25%}

[{{< fa layer-group size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #C76D62;"}
<br>

[**Multidimensional data**]{style="color: #C76D62 !important;"}

::: {.small}
Data organised along several dimensions, such as time, depth, latitude, longitude and variables

**`.netcdf`** &nbsp; **`.hdf5`**
:::
:::

::: {.column .center .fragment width=25%}

[{{< fa image size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #795F8D;"}
<br>

[**Multimedia data**]{style="color: #795F8D !important;"}

::: {.small}
Pictures, photographs, satellite imagery, illustrations, videos and audio files

**`.jpg`** &nbsp; **`.png`** &nbsp; **`.tiff`** &nbsp; **`.mp3`** &nbsp; **`.mp4`**
:::
:::

::: {.column .center .fragment width=25%}

[{{< fa book-open size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #C18A45;"}
<br>

[**Other data families**]{style="color: #C18A45 !important;"}

::: {.small}
Scientific references, compressed files, R-specific files, etc.

**`.bibtex`** &nbsp; **`.ris`** &nbsp; **`.zip`** &nbsp; **`.rds`** &nbsp; **`.rdata`**
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=12.5%}
:::

::::



## Questions to ask before choosing a format

- What is the **nature** and **structure** of my data?

<br>

- Which software and **users** will need to access the data?

<br>

- Do I need to be able to **read the content** directly?

<br>

- Are **file size** and **performance** important?

<br>

- Do I need to **preserve** metadata or complex data structures?

<br>

- Is the format suitable for sharing and **long-term preservation**?
